statement: I am a multidisciplinary practitioner engaging with art through diverse interrogation strategies, taking on roles such as educator, curator, researcher, and artist.

My work spans national and international projects, including major showcases like the Gwangju Biennale, ISEA, and SIGGRAPH. My writings have been published in respected journals such as Leonardo Electronic Almanac (LEA), CTRL+P Contemporary Art Journal, and Documenta 12.
I have participated in residency programs that focus on research and the role of art in critically addressing real-world issues.
Recently, my work has centered on exploring the influence of non-human agents in shaping our understanding of environment, nature, and the “other,” and how these factors influence human subjectivity.
bio: Ts. Dr. Roopesh Sitharan is a multidisciplinary artist, curator, researcher and academic based in Malaysia.

He is an Associate Professor at the Faculty of Creative Multimedia, Multimedia University (MMU), where he also leads the Master of Creative Multimedia programme. He is the Director of the Asia Pacific Artistic Research Network (APARN) from 2026, after convening it since 2024, and sits on the Board of Directors of the New Media Caucus.

He holds a PhD in Visual Culture from Goldsmiths, University of London, an MFA in New Media and Digital Arts from the University of California, Santa Cruz, and an MA in Curatorial Practice from California College of the Arts.
